jarlskog-cp-invariant-model-9d3e88bb.title: Jarlskog CP Invariant
jarlskog-cp-invariant-model-9d3e88bb.interpretation: Quantifies the absolute, coordinate-invariant measure of CP violation in the quark sector, dictating the strength of flavor-mixing violations.
jarlskog-cp-invariant-model-9d3e88bb.symmetry_origin: Derived from the complex phase of the CKM quark mixing matrix under flavor rotations.
jarlskog-cp-invariant-model-9d3e88bb.limits_and_boundary: Collapses to zero if any two quarks of the same charge are degenerate in mass, or if the CP-violating phase vanishes.
